name: Malgorm's War Stomp lands when its circle telegraph ends and spares players outside it
contract: npc_coa_malgorm_hollowhoof shows the circle telegraph 256108 for the two-second windup of each War Stomp 202949
(8 yd) and removes it as the stomp lands. Expected: the circle appears, then a player beside him is stunned while
the circle is gone, and a player 15 yd away is not.

steps.label: The circle telegraph shows during the windup
The stomp stuns the player beside him
The circle is gone as the stomp lands
The player outside the circle is spared
